snippet.title: Dice Looter new gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Dice Looter is an auto-battle game with dice rolling and inventory management. You need to roll dice, choose items, combine equipment, find powerful builds, and send your hero into battle.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4276810/Dice_Looter
